motion.entrance: Stepped portrait planes reveal in sequence while the name and role stay legible.
motion.idle: A very slow drift of the single matte backing form and a travelling accent along the header rule.
motion.pointer: Small differential depth between portrait, backing plane and headline.
motion.scroll: The portrait mask opens and the display type moves aside to reveal selected work.

motion.entrance: Large type reveals along a diagonal; the portrait and cobalt plane settle into place.
motion.idle: A slow, shallow rotation of the folded plane changes its shadow.
motion.pointer: The plane and portrait respond with restrained parallax.
motion.scroll: The diagonal plane becomes a transition into the work section.

motion.entrance: Name lettering reveals across the photographic depth layers.
motion.idle: A subtle orange light field evolves while the single proof teaser drifts slightly.
motion.pointer: The portrait and proof teaser have different shallow depth responses.
motion.scroll: The proof teaser expands into the OpsPilot case study.

motion.entrance: The personal name reveals behind the portrait in two complementary movements.
motion.idle: A single cobalt sculptural mark rotates slowly with subtle lighting.
motion.pointer: Small shadow and depth changes give the portrait/name composition a tactile feel.
motion.scroll: The large name contracts into the navigation as selected work enters view.

motion.entrance: The monogram turns into its opening position while identity text appears first.
motion.idle: A slow sculptural rotation and restrained reflections give the scene continuous motion.
motion.pointer: A small viewing-angle change reveals the monogram's construction.
motion.scroll: The sculpture separates into planes that introduce the selected work.
